rationale: Nitrogen is critically limiting (0.765 mM NH₄ remaining at t=32h). I am shifting to amino acid catabolism (proline, cysteine, glycine) to obtain both carbon and nitrogen. Acetate provides energy. Fermentation products (acetate, butyrate, formate, CO₂, H₂) balance the carbon budget. Growth rate limited by available nitrogen and carbon balance; modest rate (0.18 /h) is sustainable for the remaining 16 hours before culture exhaustion.
